{{Quote|Here's why you can't exterminate us, ''aruetii''. We're not huddled in one place&mdash;we span the galaxy. We need no lords or leaders&mdash;so you can't destroy our command. We can live without technology&mdash;so we can fight with our bare hands. We have no species or bloodline&mdash;so we can rebuild our ranks with others who want to join us. We're more than just a people or an army, ''aruetii''. We're a culture. We're an idea. And you can't kill ideas&mdash;but we certainly can kill you.|Ranah Teh Naast, addressing the [[Consul of Luon]]|<ref name="ImpCom" />}}
'''Ranah Teh Naast''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], and the daughter of [[Uvhen Chal]]. At some point in her life, Naast became [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']]—the traditional leader of the Mandalorians—and took up the title '''Mandalore the Destroyer'''. During her [[Time/Legends|time]] as ''Mand'alor'', Naast presided over the [[Siege of Luon|siege]] of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Luon]]. She spoke with the [[Consul of Luon|city's consul]] amidst the onslaught, outlining the strengths of the Mandalorian culture to her foe before offering the [[Consul/Legends|consul]] a final chance to surrender Luon.

==Biography==
A [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], Ranah Teh Naast was born the [[Parent/Legends|daughter]] of [[Uvhen Chal]]. Over [[Time/Legends|time]], Naast rose to claim the title and position of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']],<ref name="ImpCom" /> the traditional leader of all the Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] clans.<ref name="TMPaC">{{InsiderCite|86|The Mandalorians: People and Culture}}</ref> Following in the tradition of Mandalores who had come before, Naast adopted a descriptive epithet to set herself apart,<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> taking the sobriquet, Mandalore the Destroyer.<ref name="ImpCom" />

During her reign as ''Mand'alor'', Naast presided over Mandalorian [[Army/Legends|forces]] during [[Siege of Luon|siege]] of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Luon]]. She elected to speak with [[Consul of Luon|Luon's consul]] during the engagement, wherein Naast detailed the merits of the Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] culture, and upon outlining the Mandalorians' capacity for a strong victory, offered the [[Consul/Legends|consul]] a final opportunity to surrender the city.<ref name="ImpCom" />

==Personality and traits==
Ranah Teh Naast was a confident woman, and took pride in the heritage and culture of the Mandalorians. In a speech to the Consul of Luon, she likened her people to an idea incapable of being [[Death/Legends|killed]], inadvertently revealing her belief in the [[Immortality/Legends|immortality]] of intellectual concepts. Naast also spoke some degree of the Mandalorian [[Language/Legends|language]], [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']].<ref name="ImpCom" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ranah Teh Naast first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the form of a quote used as an epigraph for the eleventh chapter of the novel ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'', written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]], and published [[October 27]], [[2009]]. Ranah Teh Naast is the first female Mandalore established in ''Star Wars'' continuity.
